changes: New FX1/FX2 effect: your track sets eight tuned partials ringing, shared by one to four voices (VOIC on the setup page, three to start with).
TYPE gives the voices a body: PURE, STRNG, TUBE, BAR, PLATE, DRUM or BELL. DCAY lets them ring from a short knock to ten seconds.
CHRD picks the voices' chord and SCALE keeps it in a key. Lock PTCH or CHRD on trigs and the sequencer plays the ring.
The COLUN switch on the setup page (NOTE or COLUN) turns PTCH into a degree of Aleksi Perälä's Colundi sequence and tunes every voice to its frequencies.
TONE darkens or brightens what sets the ring off. MIX fades from the dry sound to the ring alone without the level jumping.
